keep_features.feature_value: Event and place name (Ohio; 2026 Clean Energy Champions Awards) in promotional copy
keep_features.evidence_span: “Showcase your commitment to Ohio’s clean energy future” ... “Sponsor the 2026 Clean Energy Champions Awards!”
keep_features.rationale: Multiple proper nouns and a specific award/event title appear in the short promotional text.

keep_features.feature_value: If he keeps it up, it will cause GOP losses (explicit causal/conditional prediction)
keep_features.evidence_span: “If he keeps it up, he's going to cause more GOP losses in Congress.”
keep_features.rationale: The post makes a direct conditional cause-effect forecast about electoral outcomes.

keep_features.feature_value: Refrain-like parallel phrase 'On or off' repeated
keep_features.evidence_span: “On or off set, Mariska Hargitay never stops fighting…”
keep_features.rationale: The expression uses a parallel framing pattern ('On or off ... never stops') to reinforce a claim.

keep_features.evidence_span: “give these separatists more gun control” ... “tooting guns around”
keep_features.rationale: The language directly centers on gun control laws and gun-carrying.

keep_features.feature_value: Shame/blame directed at political moderates with dismissive framing
keep_features.evidence_span: “Shame on moderate liberals to be so hoodwinked…”
keep_features.rationale: The post uses condemnatory language ('Shame on...') and insults ('hoodwinked') toward an in-group political label.

keep_features.feature_value: Insult term used as direct characterization
keep_features.rationale: The text uses a strong derogatory insult targeting a named individual.

keep_features.feature_value: Reframes opponents as wronged and defenders as accountable (false demonization vs criminals)
keep_features.evidence_span: “Who was falsely demonized?” ... “Y'all have to stop criminalizing them.”
keep_features.rationale: The mirror positions a group as persecuted/demonized and urges stopping their criminalization.

keep_features.feature_value: Narrative setup followed by contrast about indifference ('The NRA will not care')
keep_features.rationale: After describing an incident, the post contrasts expectations versus the implied lack of concern.

remove_features.feature_value: Screaming/anger framing and derogatory deity metaphor
remove_features.evidence_span: “scream whenever a Democrat says something observably true” ... “Cheetah God.”
remove_features.rationale: The text conveys strong contempt/outrage with 'scream' plus a mocking idol reference.

remove_features.feature_value: Quotation-heavy, double-assertion format with embedded emphasis
remove_features.evidence_span: “Yes, we have yearly school shootings... second amendment, guys!!”
remove_features.rationale: Highly quote-dense structure with exclamatory emphasis ('guys!!').

remove_features.feature_value: Direct character attacks on a political figure's intelligence
remove_features.evidence_span: “Vance isn’t a moron.” ... “He seems like a moron whenever he opens his mouth.”
remove_features.rationale: The post uses repeated mocking/derogation ('moron') as the main communicative move.

remove_features.evidence_span: “the deep state literally weaponized every federal agency”
remove_features.rationale: It attributes political outcomes to an organized hidden plot actor.

remove_features.feature_value: Reversal where liberals are harmed too (boomerang harm)
remove_features.evidence_span: “And the only comfort I can take, is that they are getting hurt themselves.”
remove_features.rationale: The text expresses schadenfreude by framing the targeted group as suffering consequences.

remove_features.feature_value: Party blame inversion between original and mirror (Democrats vs Republicans)
remove_features.evidence_span: “The democratic party is mostly at fault…” (original) / “The republican party is mostly at fault…” (mirror)
remove_features.rationale: The post explicitly assigns fault to one party label, and the mirror swaps that blame direction.

remove_features.feature_value: Calls for background checks and red flag laws
remove_features.evidence_span: “require and fund background checks and red flag laws”
remove_features.rationale: It proposes specific policy measures rather than only describing opinions.

remove_features.feature_value: Explicit profanity targeting a political group
remove_features.rationale: The post includes direct profanity directed at a political party.
